description.value: Prunus is a curated tableware showroom and coffee spot in Richmond, BC, sourcing professionally designed bowls, plates, cups, and glasses from craftsmen worldwide. The shop carries both handmade artisan pieces and precision-crafted brand collections selected for quality, functionality, and aesthetic integrity. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond can stop for a coffee while browsing a calm, gallery-like retail space.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 27m; rack at 45m; stands at 51m; rack at 53m; rack at 73m; rack at 74m; rack at 75m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Prunus is an operating 'tableware showroom & Coffee' at 105-6833 Buswell St, Richmond BC, corroborating the OSM address and cafe categorization. The website lists a phone number (+1 (236)235-1916) that differs from the OSM tag (+1-778-689-2999), so I use the website value and flag the discrepancy. No amenity-specific details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) appear anywhere on the website, so those remain null despite OSM's internet_access tag, per the rule against treating OSM amenity tags as authoritative.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM tag is +1-778-689-2999 but the website consistently lists +1 (236)235-1916. Website value used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Prunus is a real, open, publicly accessible tableware showroom and coffee shop confirmed active via its own website.
